name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Grapevine TX

fieldNotes.site: Roster address (4220 Diplomacy Rd) was flagged approximate. Web research (Racklify, multiple directories) confirms GXO Logistics' Grapevine operation is at 2425 Esters Blvd, Grapevine TX 76051 — 'DFW Trade Center VII', a multi-tenant cross-dock distribution building (GXO shares the building with ShipBob and Tornado Transport). Esters Blvd geocoded via Nominatim to ~32.9346,-97.0331, in the International Commerce Park / LINK Logistics business park on DFW Airport land, near a major highway interchange. The audited building is the cross-dock warehouse located at the locked coordinates within that park; the exact unit could not be confirmed from imagery alone but the building type matches DFW Trade Center VII's published profile (~276-298K SF, 350' depth, 32' clear, cross-dock).
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE — modern speculative multi-tenant cross-dock building. Truck courts on both long faces are open, ungated paved areas; no guard booth and no barrier arm observed at any driveway, consistent with the rest of this uniform spec-industrial park.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE — no booth structure observed in satellite or Street View anywhere on the property or in the surrounding park.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — a cross-dock building with continuous dock-door banks on both long faces; ~70 doors estimated, low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 — a moderate number of trailer-parking stalls on the truck-court aprons; neighboring park buildings carry larger trailer yards. Band is an estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout — dock banks on opposite long faces support physically separate shipping and receiving.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open truck-court aprons leave physical room for a bypass lane if a gate were added.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium — the GXO building had to be relocated from a wrong/approximate roster address to the web-confirmed 2425 Esters Blvd; the exact building unit within the DFW Trade Center park was inferred from the cross-dock building profile rather than read from a sign. The ungated gate/guard-shack determination is well-supported by the uniform character of the spec-industrial park.
